seo.title: Privacy Policy — Zad Al-Muslim
seo.description: Complete privacy policy for the Zad Al-Muslim mobile app and official website: zero ads, zero behavioral trackers, and transparent telemetry disclosures.

title: Zad Al-Muslim Privacy Policy
subtitle: Zad Al-Muslim is built as an open-source ongoing charity (Sadaqah Jariyah). We are committed to protecting your privacy with zero ads and zero commercial tracking across both the mobile app and this official website.

appSection.title: Runs locally on your device with no accounts or tracking
appSection.subtitle: The app does not require registration or email sign-in. All worship progress and preferences remain stored locally on your device.

cards.title: Local-First Worship Storage
points: Quran reading bookmarks, daily Azkar progress, Tasbih counts, and Muezzin preferences are stored locally on your device only.
This data is never uploaded to external tracking servers and cannot be accessed by us.
Uninstalling the app removes all locally stored app data from your device.

cards.title: Location Permission (GPS)
points: Coordinates are processed locally on-device for astronomical prayer time calculations and Qibla direction, without sending your location history to tracking servers.
Only when you explicitly open the Nearby Mosques map does the app query OpenStreetMap / Overpass tiles for nearby mosques.
You can skip GPS entirely and choose your city manually inside the app.

cards.title: Exact Alarms & Lockscreen Adhan
points: Exact Alarms and lockscreen display permissions are used strictly to ring the Adhan on time even under battery optimization.
The app never accesses your microphone, camera, contacts, or personal files.

cards.title: Zero Ads & Zero Analytics SDKs
points: The app contains no advertising networks, behavioral analytics SDKs, or user profiling tools.
The source code is openly auditable in our public GitHub repository.

webSection.title: Clear disclosure for browsing, APK downloads, and feedback
webSection.subtitle: The official website follows the same privacy-first ethos, explaining the minimal technical records processed for download counts and feedback submissions.

cards.title: No Advertising or Cross-Site Trackers
points: The website displays no ads and includes no third-party advertising pixels or behavioral tracking scripts.
Interactive Muezzin audio previews and the Azkar preview counter run entirely in your browser.

cards.title: Device-Matched Routing & Download Counter (/api/download)
points: When you click Download or scan a QR code, your browser and our server ephemerally inspect only your OS and CPU architecture (via standard Client Hints like Sec-CH-UA-Arch / Sec-CH-UA-Bitness or User-Agent) to route you to the lightest compatible APK (arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, or universal).

Architecture signals are evaluated solely in memory during the redirect and are never persisted; our anonymous download counter logs only the release version, chosen APK filename, button placement, and display locale. You can also select any build manually in the Download section.
We never store your IP address, raw User-Agent string, or device fingerprint, and we never set visitor tracking cookies.

cards.title: Feedback & Bug Reports (/api/feedback)
points: If you submit feedback, your message, category, locale, and optional device/contact fields are stored in our Supabase database solely to fix issues and respond if requested.
We never sell or share feedback submissions with advertisers or third parties.
If you choose to submit via GitHub Issues instead, that submission is governed by GitHub's public issue visibility and policies.

cards.title: GitHub Releases & Admin Session Cookies
points: APK downloads redirect directly to official GitHub Releases assets and are subject to GitHub's standard CDN delivery policies.
Authentication session cookies via Supabase Auth are used strictly within /admin for authorized maintainers and are never set for regular site visitors.

rightsSection.title: Full control over your permissions and submitted notes
rightsSection.subtitle: While we do not create user accounts or collect personal profiles, you have the right to request deletion of any optional contact info or feedback note you submitted.

items.title: Revoke Device Permissions Anytime
items.desc: You may disable Location or Exact Alarms in system settings at any time while continuing to use Quran, Azkar, and manual city prayer times.

items.title: Request Removal of Feedback Contact Info
items.desc: If you shared an email or handle in a feedback submission and want it deleted, contact us via the feedback form or open a request on GitHub.

items.title: Policy Updates
items.desc: Any material changes to how the app or website handles data will be clearly reflected on this page with an updated revision date.
